Round-2 PI session complete. All required files are written and validated.

## Summary

**Round 2 of 9 — normal PI research round.** I read `question.md`, the board, both live summaries, both student handoffs + derivations, the verifier report, and `pi/verified.yaml`.

**State of evidence:**
- Round-1 groundwork is **entirely verifier-confirmed**: degree 8, dual $S_3$ symmetry, purely imaginary, 5-pt calibration; the 8-word standard-sheet chamber selector; $\Delta=\prod_{m,p}(\omega_m+\omega_p)$ as a valid (not-yet-minimal) denominator; the $d_T=2(\omega_m+\omega_p)(\omega_m+\omega_q)$ factorization with only $q_T>0$ channels surviving; and that the naive minus-pair ansatz (H1) is dead.
- **One blocking gap** (verifier Finding 1): no compact closed form exists yet. This is the deliverable itself, not a repairable defect — it can only clear via a later verifier report on an actual formula. `jobs/` is empty (no completed blocking job).
- **No PI double-check** was warranted: no candidate formula, no suspected error, no student/verifier conflict — the verifier confirmed every checkable claim, so duplicating its work is against policy. Recorded that reasoning in `logic.yaml`.

**Research direction set for Round 2** — the factorization + hydrotope decomposition
$$A_6 = i\,g^{-3}\big[\,R_{\text{spline}} + \textstyle\sum_{q_T>0} A_L A_R/d_T\,\big],$$
motivated by the two confirmed facts that (a) $A_6/i$ has *genuine* denominators at integer points, so a real rational part must exist, and (b) every surviving cut factorizes onto two **known** two-minus $A_4$ amplitudes.

**Complementary, non-blocking tasks:**
- **student-1** — build the pole part $P_{\text{pole}}=\sum A_L A_R/d_T$ from the known $A_4$, fix the constant/internal-sign by one exact match, and decisively test whether $A_6/i - g^{-3}P_{\text{pole}}$ is denominator-free.
- **student-2** — own the polynomial-spline half + denominator geometry: settle $\Delta$-minimality ($D_{\min}$), extract spline bricks from pair-wall jumps (where $P_{\text{pole}}$ is continuous), propose a compact $R_{\text{spline}}$, and test sheet-independence.

Files written: `tasks/student-1.md`, `tasks/student-2.md`, `summary/logic.yaml`, `summary/group_meeting_notes.md`, session report, and appended `post_004` to `board.json` (all JSON validated). Ending the session.
